rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: ev-misev2023-quality-framework provides appropriate high-level quality and analytical expectations (confidence: moderate). It supports the need for orthogonal QC, validated intact-EV assays and stability-indicating potency assays prior to comparability/biodistribution bridging, but it cannot substitute for or prove the existence or absence of program-specific manufacturing or validation records.
findings: ISEV/MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) endorses transparent, orthogonal EV characterization, controls to distinguish vesicular from non-vesicular material, and method validation for intact-EV assays.

The allowed evidence set contains guidance but no program-specific SGL-001 MCB/WCB records, validated intact-EV QC assay validation reports, GMP-like batch release/stability data, or potency-to-PD correlation data.
Because MISEV2023 is consensus guidance, it supports what should be done but does not by itself demonstrate the absence or presence of SGL-001 program documents or results.
objections: MISEV2023 is a consensus guidance framework and does not constitute evidence that SGL-001 lacks MCB/WCB records, validated intact-EV assays, GMP-like batch release/stability data, or potency-to-PD correlation; absence of those program-specific records has not been demonstrated by the supplied evidence set.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 provides consensus support for orthogonal characterization and validated assays as prerequisites to reliable identity/potency comparisons.
claim_updates.statement: Orthogonal EV characterization and validated intact-EV assays are required before advancing formulation comparability or cross-lot biodistribution claims for SGL-001.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 emphasizes defined production controls and transparent reporting; absence of program records is unproven and must be resolved by submission of bank and scale-up data.
claim_updates.statement: Program-specific MCB/WCB characterization and scaled-manufacturing reproducibility data are required to demonstrate controlled source material and process scalability for SGL-001.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 supports the need for orthogonal analytics and appropriate controls to de-risk interpretation of in vivo delivery and functional claims across species.
claim_updates.statement: Cross-species biodistribution/efficacy bridging for intranasal SGL-001 requires orthogonal intact-EV analytics and validated recovery metrics to ensure comparability between lots and species.

decision_update.question: Is the SGL-001 package sufficient to proceed with biodistribution/comparability studies?
decision_update.rationale: Decision deferred pending submission and review of the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package described above. Guideline evidence (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports what should be provided but does not replace program-supplied records.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: MISEV2023 supports analytical and reporting expectations but does not provide program-specific manufacturing, assay validation or batch data; references to program-document absence must be treated as gaps requiring program-supplied evidence, not as proven facts derived from the guideline.

hypothesis_update.rationale: Without program-specific validated assays, MCB/WCB characterization, and reproducible batch data, observed differences could reflect analytical or manufacturing variability rather than true biological differences.
hypothesis_update.statement: Progressing to formulation/device comparability and cross-species biodistribution comparisons for SGL-001 is gated on validated identity and potency analytics and reproducible GMP-like manufacturing data.
hypothesis_update.test_plan: Require submission and review of Stage-1 CMC/analytics package (MCB/WCB records, assay validation packages, ≥3 GMP-like run data, stability/potency correlation, formulation/device compatibility) before enabling bridging studies.

proposed_changes.next_action: Assemble the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package (items 1–5 in recommendation). Submit package for internal CMC/manufacturing/evidence review. Schedule regulator briefing in parallel. Mark matter as search_needed until requested documents are provided.

risk_updates.description: Lack of validated orthogonal assays, MCB/WCB characterization, and GMP-like batch data would undermine lot-to-lot comparability and interpretation of biological data.
risk_updates.mitigation: Assemble and validate the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package; perform ≥3 GMP-like runs with release and stability testing; validate potency assay with in vivo PD correlation.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient identity and potency characterization

risk_updates.description: Without intact-EV specific recovery and orthogonal biodistribution analytics, translation of rodent delivery data to larger species is unreliable.
risk_updates.mitigation: Develop and validate intact-EV recovery assays and include appropriate controls in controlled biodistribution studies across species; require orthogonal analytics for comparability.
risk_updates.title: Uncertain cross-species intranasal delivery comparability

risk_updates.description: Functional claims based on unvalidated potency assays or non-comparable lots risk poor translation to clinical settings.
risk_updates.mitigation: Establish stability-indicating potency assay with demonstrated correlation to in vivo PD and include potency in release/stability specifications.
risk_updates.title: Model-to-human efficacy generalizability

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not proceed with formulation/device comparability or cross-lot biodistribution bridging until a Stage-1 CMC/analytics package is assembled and reviewed. Required package elements: (1) SGL-001 MCB and WCB characterization and manufacturing records; (2) a defined orthogonal QC panel including validated intact-EV assay(s) with validation parameters (LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision, linearity, robustness); (3) a stability-indicating potency assay and demonstration of correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint; (4) ≥3 GMP-like production runs with defined release and stability data showing batch-to-batch reproducibility; (5) formulation/device compatibility studies (ex vivo and in vivo) demonstrating intact-EV recovery with appropriate controls. Prepare these reports for internal CMC review and plan a regulatory briefing (pre-IND/Scientific Advice) in parallel. The program decision on advancing into biodistribution/comparability requires human approval and is pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 consensus supports the need for an orthogonal QC panel and validated intact-EV assays before advancing formulation/comparability; the supplied program evidence does not include SGL-001 MCB/WCB records, validated assay reports, or GMP-like batch release and stability data and therefore is insufficient to conclude the program meets the stated CMC gate.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing SGL-001 MCB/WCB documentation, validated intact-EV QC assay validation reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision), GMP-like batch release and stability data, and stability-indicating potency assay correlation to in vivo PD.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 supports the requirement for defined production controls and orthogonal characterization; the allowed evidence set contains no program-specific scale-up or reproducibility data for SGL-001, so current materials do not demonstrate characterized MCB/WCB or reproducible scale-up sufficient to advance formulation comparability work.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: No scaled-manufacturing batch records, scale-up protocols, or comparability study data provided for SGL-001.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: The ISEV/MISEV2023 consensus (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) provides the strongest supporting evidence that orthogonal characterization, controls for non-vesicular particles, and validated assays are needed to de-risk identity and potency claims. The supplied evidence does not include program-specific in vivo bridging biodistribution or intact-EV analytics needed to assess cross-species delivery or lot-to-lot comparability for SGL-001.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing program-specific intact-EV orthogonal assay data, validated LLOQ/specificity/precision, controlled cross-species biodistribution/bridging studies, and formulation/device compatibility reports.

verification_objections: Assertion that the supplied program evidence includes or does not include SGL-001-specific MCB/WCB documentation (no program-specific bank records are present in the allowed evidence set, but this absence cannot be demonstrated by the MISEV guidance alone).

Assertion that validated orthogonal QC assay validation reports for SGL-001 (including LLOQ, specificity, precision) are missing — the MISEV guidance does not contain program-specific assay validation files and therefore cannot be used to demonstrate their absence.

Assertion that GMP-like batch release and stability data for SGL-001 are missing — MISEV is a consensus guideline and does not supply batch records, so it cannot be used to prove absence of program GMP-like runs or their results.

Assertion that a stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint for SGL-001 is missing — MISEV recommends such assays but does not contain program-specific potency validation or correlation data to demonstrate its absence.

Assertion that controlled cross-species biodistribution or formulation/device compatibility data for SGL-001 are missing — the guideline does not include or exclude program-specific biodistribution or device compatibility studies, so their absence is not established by the allowed evidence.
